dogecoin.text:
'No DOGE in D.O.G.E.', Says Dogecoin Proponent Elon Musk (CoinDesk). 

Speaking at an America PAC town hall in Wisconsin on Sunday, Musk said there were no plans to use memecoin dogecoin (DOGE) for government operations.

Dogecoin (DOGE) lost 19.4% in the past week, while its market cap dropped from $24.67 billion to $19.78 billion.

DOGE’s technical outlook also looks bleak, having fallen below the $0.15 support. A death cross pattern and bearish signals from RSI and MACD suggest further downside
